taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: Pod Security Standards; choose the applicable Kubernetes version and OS

controls.boundary: Kubernetes workload admission and host isolation — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read the admitted pod spec for all init/sidecar/app containers, host mounts/namespaces, security context and enforced admission policy. Record node/runtime and workload identity.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect whether a lower-trust submitter can obtain the host/device/capability access alleged by the finding. Use read-only evidence or an owned isolated replica; trace admission result to the effective container configuration rather than a manifest that was never admitted.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A missing hardening recommendation is not automatically a reachable escape. A privileged-looking source manifest rejected by admission does not prove deployed authority.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the required isolation at admission/runtime and remove unnecessary host authority while preserving required workloads. Retest the original submitted configuration and an approved deployment.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
